title: NEKOPARA Vol. 4
provenance: Reported by FloraKira (upstream#232, 2026-09-27), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0, KLYC-Box 0.9.35, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r7, Wine's own Direct3D, Windows 11, AVX advertised, DLL overrides winhttp=n,b;emotedriver=n,b, rated 4 of 5 after 27 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Visual novel with E-mote animated characters. Reported playable on Wine's own Direct3D: in the other modes it dropped frames the whole time, on Wine's Direct3D only while an animated (Live2D style) scene plays. The reporter's environment carried the DLL overrides winhttp=n,b and emotedriver=n,b, which were not tested apart. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Frame drops throughout on DXMT and DXVK, and during animated character scenes on Wine's own Direct3D (reported on an M5 Pro, engine r7).
knownIssues.fix: use Wine's own Direct3D, the mode the reporter settled on.

wined3d.detail: playable, frame drops only in animated scenes (reported, M5 Pro)
